hints.title: Prioritize Ladders for Largest Jumps
hints.text: A ladder covers any height difference with cost one, so allocate ladders to the largest positive jumps.

hints.title: Maintain Min-Heap of Ladder Jumps
hints.text: Insert positive height differences into a min-heap until heap size exceeds ladder count.

hints.title: Use Bricks for Smallest Jumps
hints.text: Pop the smallest jump from heap and spend that many bricks; stop when remaining bricks become negative.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive search over ladder placement decisions yields 2^n possibilities.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap maintains the largest k jumps in O(log ladders) per building.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize greedy choice property: ladders cover largest jumps, bricks cover the rest.
